meta.inspection: All 35 images individually opened using view_image. No source, keys or other judges read. Phone-like landscape display scale.
meta.anchors: Exact prior scores retained for visibly unchanged known controls. Additional historical-looking images have differences including hard rectangular wakes and circular particles; those were judged directly, not assigned a prior near-match score.
meta.blinding_limitations: Visual families and repeated controls recognizable; sci-fi resembles StarCraft, battlefields Company of Heroes; tactical title uncertain. No verified identity/iteration used.

general_next_priorities: Retain more transparent smoke, which reveals aircraft better than dense opaque rosettes. Reduce equal-weight orange impacts and dark shadow disks further in dense action.
Ocean's long parallel streaks look like blur or rain rather than a water surface. Restore multi-scale curved/crossing wave structure with restrained contrast.
Dark segmented coastal edge looks like a geometry seam. Resolve shoreline continuity and use coherent shallows/surf or a lit cliff face.
Airfield apron is useful structure, but keep its transition and grass texture quieter; blue aircraft/blue roof ambiguity persists.
Wake breakup is more fluid than hard rectangles, but identical repeated puffs look stamped; vary width/opacity and spacing along age.
Do not treat added detail as depth automatically: several dark hull faces and tree contacts remain nearly solid black despite richer geometry.
